## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

  "id": "journal_raw_b3_01_quartermaster_the_crossover",
  "text": "The crossover point I projected at Day 100 has not arrived. It will not arrive this month. Greenhouse production is up to eleven percent of caloric need, which sounds like progress until you do the arithmetic: eleven percent of forty-seven people is five point one seven people. We are feeding five people from the greenhouse and slowly starving the other forty-two from the stores. The rice is at thirty-eight kilos. I have stopped writing the days-supply number on the board because the number makes people quiet in a way I do not like. The Chef asked me this morning what the plan is. I told her the plan is to plant more turnips. She did not laugh. She said turnips are not a plan. I know they are not a plan. They are a vegetable.",
  "timestamp": "Day 118, 09h",

}

## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The entry says greenhouse production covers eleven percent of the caloric need of forty-seven people, estimates that as 5.17 people, and says five are being fed by it while forty-two still depend on stores. Rice is at thirty-eight kilos; the days-supply number has been removed from the board because of its effect on people. The Chef calls turnips a vegetable, not a plan. Do not forecast a harvest or replace the exact shortage with optimism. Candidate language may add an image, rhythm, or private impression as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a further remembered event or a confirmed fact until the existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.

## 5. Human center

The source voice is The Quartermaster. The Quartermaster writes in exact arithmetic, then refuses to let arithmetic pretend to be a plan. Keep the voice tired, dry, and attentive to the people hidden inside a denominator. The prose may notice what the author can count, hear, repair, fear, or leave uncertain, while keeping the account’s limits visible.
